system: complex qubit times Fock oscillator; finite untouched reference; G=n+P_e
primary_generator: H_x=x sigma_x (a+a_dagger), unit dimensionless slot duration
general_generator: omega n+Delta P_e+g A+h B; omega>0 on D(n)
source: K0=sqrt(s(1-q)) V0; K1=sqrt(sq) V1; Kf=sqrt(1-s) I; s=1-q/2
preparation_failure: prep_fail with vacuum reset and actual failure-conditioned reference

calibration.drive_input: fresh plus_x probe and oscillator vacuum
calibration.drive_tester: binary effect momentum p<=0, p=(a-a_dagger)/(i sqrt(2)); probability Phi(2x)
calibration.nominal_x_rule: deterministic certified inverse of observed drive frequency, rounded to a rational grid
calibration.device_errors: unmeasured; ideal tester/preparation/shared gates remain assumptions

prohibited_inferences: small state tail is not Galerkin error
flag probabilities do not identify x
finite-cutoff gate is not assumed implementable
finite tester data do not certify full trace distance
no new Lean acceptance is inferred
